name: War Remnants Museum
nameVi: Bảo tàng Chứng tích Chiến tranh
kicker: Courtyard aircraft and three floors of photographs
summary: War museum on Võ Văn Tần: walk the courtyard aircraft and three floors of photographs, open 7:30–17:30. Last admission is 17:00. An adult ticket from 1 October 2026 is 60,000 đồng. Pupils and students book a free ticket online before they arrive. Another listed adult figure is 15,000 đồng.
fee: 60,000 đồng for an adult from 1 October 2026. 15,000 đồng is also listed.
getThere: A short ride from the palace.
heroCaption: A U.S. Air Force jet in the museum courtyard

notice.title: Students book a free ticket online
notice.body: From 1 October 2026, pupils and students book a free ticket online before arrival. The half-price row is 30,000 đồng. Children are free at the desk. Another listed adult figure is 15,000 đồng.

body: Tickets are at the main gate, 28 Võ Văn Tần, Phường Xuân Hòa, with parking at the side gate on Lê Quý Đôn. The older label is Ward 6, District 3. Three floors hold artifacts and photographs, including Nick Ut’s “The Terror of War,” and the courtyard holds aircraft, tanks, bombs, and helicopters. The photograph here is the courtyard jet.

Dress for the galleries, leave food outside them, and ask about filming. Children under 10 need an adult. From 1 October 2026 the hours are 7:30–17:30 every day including Tết. The ticket desk runs 7:30–17:00, and the museum stops admitting visitors at 17:00. Another clock is 7:30 a.m.–12 p.m. and 1:30–5 p.m.

legs.body: The museum is on Võ Văn Tần.

hours: From 1 October 2026: 7:30–17:30 every day including Tết. Ticket desk 7:30–17:00. Last admission 17:00. Another clock is 7:30 a.m.–12 p.m. and 1:30–5 p.m.
admissionNote: From 1 October 2026. Adult, domestic or international, outside a reduced class: 60,000 đồng. Half price, 30,000 đồng: people 60 and over, people with severe disabilities, people with meritorious service, cultural-benefit categories, ethnic minorities in specially difficult communes, and people’s artisans and eminent artisans. Free, booked online before arrival: pupils, students, and members of poor or near-poor households. Free at the desk: children, and people with especially severe disabilities, with a parent or relative. Papers are checked. Another listed adult figure is 15,000 đồng.
